source.author: cic
source.text: nec vero probare soleo id quod de Pythagoreis accepimus, quos ferunt, si quid affirmarent in disputando, cum ex iis quaereretur quare ita esset, respondere solitos ipse dixit; ipse autem erat Pythagoras: tantum opinio praeiudicata poterat, ut etiam sine ratione valeret auctoritas.
source.text_original: nec vero probare soleo id quod de Pythagoreis accepimus, quos ferunt, si quid affirmarent in disputando, cum ex iis quaereretur quare ita esset, respondere solitos ipse dixit; ipse autem erat Pythagoras: tantum opinio praeiudicata poterat, ut etiam sine ratione valeret auctoritas.
source.text_english: Nor indeed do I usually approve that report which we have received about the Pythagoreans, namely that, if in debate they affirmed anything, and when they were asked why it was so, they were accustomed to reply, he himself said it; and he himself, of course, was Pythagoras. So great was the force of preconceived opinion that authority could prevail even without reason.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: neque enim tanta est meae pusillitatis auctoritas, qui nihil sum et inuidorum tantum morsibus pateo, quanta eorum, qui nos in domino praecesserunt, nec iuxta Pythagorae discipulos praeiudicata doctoris opinio, sed doctrinae ratio ponderanda est.
reuse.text_original: neque enim tanta est meae pusillitatis auctoritas, qui nihil sum et inuidorum tantum morsibus pateo, quanta eorum, qui nos in domino praecesserunt, nec iuxta Pythagorae discipulos praeiudicata doctoris opinio, sed doctrinae ratio ponderanda est.
reuse.text_english: For the authority of my insignificance is not so great—I am nothing and am open only to the bites of the envious—as is that of those who have gone before us in the Lord; and, unlike the followers of Pythagoras, the preconceived opinion of the teacher is not to be weighed, but rather the soundness of the teaching itself.
